title: Idea prize titbit.
html_source:
Bloom considers a detective story for the writing prize offered by the magazine Titbit he was reading in the outhouse in chapter four. The detective could read clues from the blotting pad a suspect had used.

Bloom’s guilt about writing to Martha makes him feel criminal.
